summary.description: A friendly, specific update acknowledging verified progress and distinguishing new findings from existing discussions, without a readiness verdict.

path.description: Repository-relative path to a file changed by the pull request.

start_line.description: First changed line covered by the comment. Use the same value as line for a single-line comment.

line.description: Last changed line covered by the comment on the right-hand side of the diff.

body.description: A concise explanation of the issue, why it matters, and what should change.

replacement.description: Exact replacement for the selected lines, or an empty string when a safe edit cannot be supplied.

existing_thread_id.description: ID of an existing unresolved thread about the same issue, even if its wording or location changed. Use an empty string only for a new finding.

component_issues.description: Component bugs directly uncovered while verifying changed documentation. Match existing issues before proposing a new one. The publisher, not the reviewer, files or links issues.

component.description: The affected docs component directory, such as button or radio-buttons.

failure_key.description: Stable name for the underlying failure, independent of versions, wording, PRs, and commits. Reuse the key in an existing warp-docs-component-key marker for the same bug.

docs_path.description: Changed component documentation that led to this finding.

docs_line.description: An added line in docs_path connecting the bug to the reviewed claim.

expectation_source.description: A primary requirement verified from available material: a full-commit GitHub permalink in a WARP repo, a W3C accessibility requirement, or Apple, Android, or Figma design guidance. The changed docs claim alone cannot establish the expectation.

affected_versions.description: Exact tested packages/versions and relevant runtime or platform versions.

procedure.description: A self-contained test or exact steps actually executed against the real implementation, including commands and required setup. Never invent a run.

observed_result.description: The observed output or failure from that execution, including expected versus actual results.

upstream_evidence.description: How the failure was checked against the latest source snapshot, separately from the affected published version.

commit_sha.description: The source_sha for this repository in .component-context.json.

path.description: Path inside the component repository, without the .review-sources prefix.

excerpt.description: Exact text of the selected source lines. The publisher verifies this against GitHub.

existing_issue_number.description: An issue from the supplied repository context about the same underlying problem, including closed issues; otherwise 0.

existing_fix_number.description: A merged fix PR from the supplied context when upstream_status is fixed; otherwise 0.

thread_updates.description: Re-checks of existing unresolved bot threads. Omitted threads remain open.

thread_id.description: An existing thread ID from the supplied review context.

status.description: Use fixed only after verifying the correction in the current documentation or implementation. Outdated anchors alone are not evidence of a fix.

reason.description: A short explanation of the current evidence, identifying the text or code that fixes the finding when status is fixed.
